{{Quote|Midlis are tasked with overseeing the Workers, so they're not ''that'' intelligent. But they can be reasoned with, and can handle equipment to a limited extent.|[[Nyama]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Midlis''' were a caste of the [[Quesoth]], an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. The Midlis possessed less intelligence that the Quesoth [[Circling]]s, but had a far greater level of intelligence than the Quesoth [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] and [[Worker (Quesoth)|Workers]], and they also had a limited ability to use equipment. The Midlis' primary duties were to oversee the Quesoth Workers and the highest position available to a Midli was to become the bowlcarrier of the Quesoth [[Queen/Legends|Queen]].
